description: Add a sketch of a straight stem joined to a hooked arc, approximated by segments — a ready-made path for onshape_sweep.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

hook_angle.description: Sweep of the hook in degrees (default 210).

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Candy cane centerline").

plane.description: Default plane to sketch on (default Front).

segments.description: Total segments used to approximate the path (default 24).

straight_height.description: Length of the straight stem, inches.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_sketch_candy_cane_path
title: Sketch a hooked sweep path
